_comment: Populate this after downloading each whitelisted tool once from its vendor site, per docs/usb-layout.md#fetching-and-checksumming-tools and docs/tool-whitelist.md. Build-Kit.ps1 refuses to place a binary on the USB whose SHA-256 doesn't match the value recorded here. Empty/placeholder entries are skipped with a warning, not silently trusted — see docs/status.md.

tools.name: microsoft-safety-scanner
tools._unpinned_reason: MSERT bundles its own malware signatures and expires ~10 days after download, so the binary legitimately differs on every build and a pinned hash would always be stale. Build-Kit logs the actual SHA-256 of the copy it ships.
tools._note: 64-bit MSERT. Verify the fwlink still resolves to msert.exe at build time. An expired binary reports as expired rather than clean - see docs/tool-invocations.md.

tools.name: adwcleaner
tools._note: Malwarebytes distributes a fresh download link per release rather than a stable URL - resolve at build time.

tools.name: smartmontools
tools._note: No official portable build - extract smartctl.exe from the NSIS installer at build time, see docs/usb-layout.md.

tools.name: speedtest-cli
tools._note: Pin the actual current version - this URL is illustrative, verify against Ookla's published download page at build time.

tools.name: nirsoft-suite
tools._note: NirSoft ships each utility as a separate download - assemble the subset actually referenced by CLAUDE.md (BlueScreenView etc.) rather than the entire catalog.
